title: Reset demo from any non-dashboard page strands the page on a permanent spinner — no navigation, no route refetch (r1 #13 fold did not land)
evidence: UserClickedResetDemo -> reset_demo(model)  // demo_update.gleam:176 … fn reset_demo(model) { case demo_store.seed() { Ok(store) -> { … #( Model(..model, demo_store: Some(store), … vacancy_detail: NotAsked, leaderboard: NotAsked, application_detail: NotAsked, comparison_details: NotAsked, archived_vacancies: NotAsked, … toasts: [], ), demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications), } — no modem.push / no route-data refetch. vacancy_detail.gleam:26: `NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()` (same at application_detail.gleam:40, archived_vacancies.gleam:50, comparison.gleam:54). shell.gleam:37: `True -> demo_banner.view_demo_banner()` — Reset button is on every demo page.
detail: Reset on detail/application/archived/comparison routes sets their data to NotAsked; views render view_loading() forever because the only effect fired refetches notifications. Briefing's warning fold "reset navigates home" is unimplemented.
recommended_fix: In reset_demo, add modem.push("/demo", None, None) to the effect batch (or refetch the current route's data after re-seeding).

title: Demo refcheck actions fire "re_enable"/"take_over" but the shared toast mapping matches "re-enable"/"take-over" — both fall through to the wrong 'Referee substituted' copy
evidence: demo_update.gleam:484 `RefcheckReEnable -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "re_enable")`; :494 `fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "take_over")`. client.gleam:3110-3116 `let toast_copy = case action { "start" -> copy.refcheck_toast_started "skip" -> copy.refcheck_toast_skipped "re-enable" -> copy.refcheck_toast_re_enabled "take-over" -> copy.refcheck_toast_taken_over "correct" -> copy.refcheck_toast_corrected _ -> copy.refcheck_toast_substituted }` (real flow sends hyphens: client.gleam:2881 "re-enable", :2974 "take-over"). copy.gleam:941 `pub const refcheck_toast_substituted: String = "Referee substituted - the new invitation is on its way."`
detail: Reachable via a-tom's queued reference (hooks True): take-over and skip→re-enable both confirm with "Referee substituted — the new invitation is on its way." Store mutates correctly (apply_refcheck keys on underscores); only the toast misleads.
recommended_fix: Send "re-enable"/"take-over" from demo_update to match the toast mapping (demo_store.apply_refcheck keys updated to hyphen forms).

title: Newly created demo vacancy renders 'Closes today' — days_remaining is a static fixture lookup returning 0, contradicting closes_at = now + validity_days
evidence: demo_store.gleam:744-749 `fn demo_days_remaining(vacancy_id: String) -> Int { case vacancy_id { "v-maples" -> 14 "v-harbour" -> 21 _ -> 0 } }` (used at :735 and :781 for every derived surface); create_vacancy sets `let closes_at = add_days_iso(now, payload.validity_days)` (:1064) for ids "v-demo-*". vacancy_card.gleam:54-58 `Active if v.days_remaining <= 0 -> … [html.text("Closes today")]`; vacancy_detail.gleam:347 `case v.days_remaining <= 3 && !v.is_archived {` (closing-soon banner). Create submits active: client.gleam:5993 `False -> submit_vacancy(model, "active")`.
detail: The r1 #23 symptom persists in the rendered field: a fresh 14–30-day demo vacancy shows "Closes today" plus the closing-soon banner because days_remaining never derives from closes_at for created ids.
recommended_fix: Derive days_remaining from closes_at (parse the ISO date) for non-fixture vacancies instead of the `_ -> 0` fallback.

title: Creating two demo vacancies whose cleaned names share the first 8 chars produces duplicate vacancy ids and short_codes — no uniqueness guard
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1030 `let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix`; :1055 `short_code: "RTDEMO" <> suffix`; id_suffix (:1548-1560) `case string.length(cleaned) { n if n <= 8 -> cleaned n -> string.drop_end(cleaned, n - 8) }` — no counter/uniqueness check; find_vacancy uses `list.find(store.vacancies, fn(v) { v.vacancy.id == vacancy_id })` returning the first match.
detail: Creating "Maples" twice (or any names sharing the 8-char prefix) yields two store entries with the same id/short_code; detail, archive, close and publish all silently target the first vacancy.
recommended_fix: Disambiguate the suffix on collision (append a counter until the id is unused in the store).
